pass_mark: Fixed on 2026-10-09 before any number of a held-back leg was read. The scored number at a station is the solver's echo-sounder depth less the reading. Over all scored stations of the ten held-back legs: the median within 10 m, and at least 0.80 of the stations within 20 m. For each held-back leg with 20 or more scored stations: its median within 15 m. The solver passes when all three hold. Medians, because the sounder's errors are one-sided: it hears the shallowest point inside its beam.
